The wiki-maintenance session keeps this in sync with the prose backlog pages (ideas/cleanup-backlog.md, ideas/tooling-backlog.md). items.title: Inline links whose declared entry_id resolves, but not to the link's own base form (real entry, wrong word)
items.detect: python3 build/check_link_baseform.py --summary   # queue 0; --no-allowlist shows the 99 allowlisted same-word pairs
items.filter: The detector now applies the three normalizations itself (headword identity, which subsumes the affix case; suru-verb base -> noun entry; lookup-key affix). What it reports is the real queue. Triage the report into (a) WRONG WORD -- base and declared headword are different words sharing a reading (compounds: 機能/昨日, 性格/正確; kanji-variant verbs: 立てる/建てる, 治る/直る) -- repair to `proposal`; and (b) BENIGN -- the declared entry is the same word under a kana headword or variant spelling (頃/〜ころ, 上げる/あげる, 焼きたて/焼き立て) -- leave alone. Family (b) is why this item is verify:per-entry and must never be swept.
items.notes: Detector shipped 2026-07-31 (routine systemic-fix): build/check_link_baseform.py, read-only, same CLI shape as check_link_targets.py (--summary/--json/--count/--by-base/--resolvable/--ambiguous/--range). Dictionary-wide over 265,173 links: 256,094 agree, 7,310 noentry, 870 no lookup hit, 227 accepted by headword identity, 267 by the suru-noun rule, 0 by the affix path (headword identity subsumes it), 405 disagree. FIRST BATCH DONE 2026-07-31: the compound-homophone class -- both base and declared headword all-kanji, 2+ chars -- swept entirely, 87 occurrences / 64 entries, every one verified in context before applying and every repair 1:1 with no ambiguity (機能->昨日, 状況->上京, 電気->伝記, 性格->正確, 福祉->副詞, 会社->外車, 結婚式->結婚). 228 remain after the second batch. The remainder is harder per link, not easier: it is dominated by the benign orthographic family (頃->〜ころ 24, 上げる->あげる 18, 通り->どおり 5) that must be LEFT ALONE, interleaved with genuine kanji-variant verb errors (立てる->建てる 11, 治る->直る 7, 合う->会う 6, 越える->超える, 量る->測る) that need sense judgment against the example sentence. Next batch should take the kanji-variant verb pairs one base form at a time. 12 findings are ambiguous (>1 lookup candidate) and belong to the curator. Note for the curator: once the queue is worked down, `check_link_baseform.py --count` is ratchet-ready in the same way the dead-target gate is -- this class is invisible to every semantic instrument (the §4 accuracy self-check over the same 64 entries returned zero findings on it). SECOND BATCH DONE 2026-08-01 (routine systemic-fix): the kanji-variant pair class swept across 18 base-form families -- 90 links / 64 entries, each family adjudicated once against the example sentence and every occurrence in it verified in context. Families repaired: 立てる->01196 (from 建てる), 抑える->12806 (from 押さえる), 治る->19598 (from 直る), 合う->10466 (from 会う/遭う), 混む->02574 (from 込む), 越える->02099, 量る->28293, 返す->09648 (from 帰す), 替える->13399 (from 変える/換える), 温める->02096 (from 暖める), 上る->21460 (from 登る), 刺す->02111 (from 挿す), 張る->12583 (from 貼る, and one from 00627 春), 臨む->29038 (from 望む), 聴く->30010 (from 聞く), 挙げる->27889, 揚げる->16879 (both from あげる/上げる), 固い->12090 (from 硬い). 320 -> 230 disagreements; dead targets still 0. Verifying the DECISION SET (18 families) rather than the occurrence set was again the right decomposition -- cf. the P27 retro. What remains is the benign orthographic family plus a handful needing real judgment (街/町, 羽/羽根, 後/跡, 欠ける/かける, 被る->18070_koumuru which is a different reading and must be rejected) and the 13 ambiguous findings that belong to the curator. THIRD BATCH DONE 2026-08-03 (routine systemic-fix): the noun-homophone class -- base is a (mostly single-kanji) noun or bound morpheme, declared headword a different word sharing the reading -- swept across 34 decision families, 51 links / 36 entries. Every family is a pair of different words sharing a reading where the declared target is plainly the other word: 参加する->25408 (from 酸化), クリーム->00253 (from クレーム), オタク->15181 (from お宅), 深い->01211 (from 薄い), 離す->19372 (from 話す), 掘る->00442 (from 彫る), 囲う->12005 (from 下降), 効く->01932 (from 聞く), 利く->11845 (from 効く, 3 links), 嫌->10232 (from 否), 辺り->01770 (from 当たり), 解消する->21324 (from 快勝), 込む->00719 (from 混む), 切る->02693 (from 着る, 2), 変える->01089 (from 帰る, 2), 返る->29164 (from 帰る), 冷める->02114 (from 覚める, 2), 応える->09893 (from 答える, 2), 載せる->28290 (from 乗せる, 2), 熱い->09888 (from 暑い), 温かい->13395 (from 暖かい, 2), 締める->10057 (from 閉める), 充てる->18707 (from 当てる), 務める->10446 (from 勤める), 生ける->10667 (from いける), 何か->03873 (from 何), 上げる->02443 (from 上がる, the transitive/intransitive slip), 長い->00491 (from 長〜, 2), and the noun-vs-suru-verb pair 入院->02091 / 退院->02090 which had been cross-linked to each other's する entry. 179 -> 140; dead targets still 0; the §4 furigana screen over the 33 changed entries produced 2 flags, both rejected (documented okurigana-split noise, and one hallucinated kanji). Reconfirmed benign and LEFT ALONE: 様->01114_you (base written with the kanji of よう; target correct), 臭い->00874_nioi (臭い/匂い are spellings of the same におい), 羽->03696_hane (羽根 is the same word; the proposal 01007_wa is the bird counter and would be wrong), 空く->00756_suku (すいている), 球/玉, 下/元. One judgment case deferred: 03654_yutaka links {採|と}れる 'to be harvested' to 00565_toru (取る), and the proposal 02376_toreru glosses only 'to come off' -- neither fits. What remains is still dominated by the benign orthographic family (頃 24, 上げる 18, 付ける 7, 通り 5, 焼きたて 4, 追いかける 3, いい 3, 被る 3, 捩じる 8 -- all within-entry) plus the 13 ambiguous findings reserved for the curator. FIFTH BATCH DONE 2026-08-05 (routine systemic-fix): the judgment tail plus the entire 'ambiguous' bucket -- 19 decision families, 30 links / 24 entries. Method addition: the 13 findings marked ambiguous (>1 lookup candidate) were NOT curator work; the surface furigana names the reading and selects one candidate outright. Repaired by reading-match: 後->09580_ato (5 links, from 跡), 分->26216_bun (2, from 文), 船->09875_sen (2, from 千), 方->10665_kata (from 肩), 館->17308_kan (from 缶). Repaired wrong-word families from the resolvable queue: 要る->09589_iru (2, from いる 'to exist'), 欠ける->13167_kakeru (3, from かける 'to hang'), 利く->11845_kiku (3, from 効く), 蕎麦->14329_soba (from そば 'beside'), 湧く->13321_waku_welling (from 沸く), 痛める->13613_itameru (from 傷める), 修行->05522_shugyou (from 修業), and the na-adjective attributive copula 失礼な->09497_na (from の) in 06720_akireru. Grammatical patterns relinked from their component word to the dedicated pattern entry: てしまう->03102_teshimau (from 仕舞う), につれて->28400_nitsurete (from 連れて), のように->30291_noyouni (from ように 'so that'), 楽しみにする->26825_tanoshiminisuru (from 楽しみ). Two BASE-LABEL repairs where the target was already right and the label was imprecise: 04959_dango's counter links {一本}->〜本 and {一個}->〜個 rebased to 一本/一個 (cf. the お得 case in batch 3). 144 -> 114; dead targets still 0; ambiguous 13 -> 1; the §4 furigana screen over the 24 changed entries returned 0 flags. LEFT ALONE with reasons: 05020_youtsuu とき->10077_toki (the declared target IS the same word under a kana headword; the finding is an artifact of the 02918/10077 near-duplicate pair -- logged as a consolidation candidate); 00233_kingyo すくい->09994_sukuu (declared target 'to scoop' is correct for 金魚すくい -- the proposal 12884_sukui '救い salvation' would be wrong); 04230_uchiakeru 明ける->00563 (the notes gloss it '(to open)' and NEITHER entry fits -- 21288_akeru is 'to dawn; to end a period'; deferred to the curator). What remains is overwhelmingly the benign orthographic family that must never be swept (頃 24, 上げる 18, 捩じる 8, 付ける 7, 通り 5, 焼きたて 4, 霞む 4, いい/良い 4, 羽 3, 被る 3, 追いかける 3) plus a thin tail of same-word spelling variants (造る/作る, 観る/見る, 硬い/固い, 暖まる/温まる, 生む/産む, 差す/挿す・指す・射す) that need sense judgment rather than repair. | 2026-08-06: the 13 'ambiguous' findings four batches deferred to the curator were ALL decidable -- the surface's own furigana names the reading and the reading selects one candidate (後 あと->09580, 分 ぶん->26216, 船 せん->09875, 方 かた->10665, 館 かん->17308). Lookup ambiguity is not decision ambiguity; apply the reading filter before bucketing. The one genuine residual (05020_youtsuu) is a symptom of the 02918/10077 とき duplication, not a link error. SIXTH BATCH DONE 2026-08-06 (routine systemic-fix): the judgment tail -- 13 decision families, 13 links / 12 entries, everything outside the benign orthographic family. Two classes. (a) BOUND SUFFIX mislinked to its free-standing homophone: 開放的 (00445) and 外交的な (02627) both linked 〜的 to 03546_teki 敵 'enemy' instead of the suffix entry 09839_teki -- the proposal 19356_mato 的 まと was correctly ignored because its reading does not match the surface furigana てき. (b) KANJI-VARIANT pairs where each spelling has its own entry, repaired to the entry matching the written surface (the batch-2 rule): 観る->22793 (from 00283 見る, ストリーミングで映画を観る), 生む->29531 (from 01899 産む, 電流を生む 'generate'), 硬い->01116 (from 12090 固い, 表情が硬い), 暖まる->01856 (from 02095 温まる), 造る->17751 (from 00481 作る, がっちり造られている), 放す->29986 (from 19372 離す, the 手放す etymology note), and the whole 差す family -> 17637 (from 02466 挿す x2, 02056 指す, 02468 射す: 目薬を二滴差す, 月明かりが差す, 物差しの差し, 日が差した). One BASE-LABEL repair: 05653_gacchiri's ⟦{作|つく}り→造る：00481⟧ had the right target and the wrong label -- relabelled 作る (cf. お得 in batch 3, 一本/一個 in batch 5). 114 -> 101; dead targets still 0; the §4 furigana screen over the 12 changed entries returned 0 flags. LEFT ALONE with reasons: 控えめ->09160 控え目, 見積もり->04699 見積り, 巨大な->02586 巨大 (na-form vs noun entry), 一昨年->02895 and 明後日->00828 (same word under a kana headword, reading matches; the proposals 15474 いっさくねん / 00301 みょうごにち are different readings). Finding of this batch: the surviving benign family is mostly a symptom of NEAR-DUPLICATE ENTRY PAIRS, not of link errors -- 09160/17234 控え目, 04699/05153 見積り, 08344/16735 焼き立て, 03937/04474 捻る, 04628/16734 追い掛ける, 02586/25544 巨大 -- so consolidating those pairs, not more link work, is what removes ~20 permanent findings from this queue. Detector improvement filed: accept a na-adjective normalization (strip trailing な from the base before the headword-identity test) the same way the suru-noun rule is accepted. RESOLVED 2026-08-06 (routine systemic-fix, batch 7 = closeout): the two judgment cases deferred by batches 4 and 5 were both decidable and repaired -- 03654_yutaka's {採|と}れる relinked from 00565_toru 取る to 20862_toru 採る (whose sense 1 is exactly 'pick/gather/extract from the environment', fitting 石油や天然ガスがたくさん採れる), and 04230_uchiakeru's etymology note {明|あ}ける base-relabelled 明ける -> 開ける against the already-correct target 00563_akeru (the note's own gloss is '(to open)'; 21288_akeru 'to dawn' does not fit, so this is a base-label repair like お得 and 一本, not a target change). That emptied the queue of every finding that link repair can fix. The surviving 99 are, family by family, the SAME word reached under a different spelling -- string comparison cannot see it and no normalization generalizes it safely -- so they are now recorded as verified (base, target) pairs in build/data/link_baseform_allowlist.json, each with a written reason and a class: 20 variant-spelling families (頃 24, 上げる 18, 付ける 7, 通り 5, いい/良い 4, 羽 3, 被る 3, 空く 2, and 12 singletons) and 7 near-duplicate-pair families (捩じる 8, 焼きたて 4, 霞む 4, 追いかける 3, 控えめ, 見積もり, 時) that are consolidation work, not link errors. With the allowlist absorbing them the queue is 0, so the ratchet this item has been calling for since 2026-07-31 is armed: check_link_baseform.py --gate runs in .github/workflows/validate.yml and fails any PR that introduces a link resolving to the wrong word. Negative-tested (dropping the 頃 pair reproduces a 24-link FAIL), so it is a live gate, not a permanently-green no-op. Why an allowlist rather than a numeric floor: the benign families GROW with normal entry creation (every new entry linking 頃 adds one), so a count ratchet at 99 would have failed ordinary new-entry PRs while still tolerating a real wrong-word link that displaced an allowlisted one. Follow-on: entry-pair-consolidation.

items.title: semantic == ['action'] on a verb (tautological — carries no information the POS lacks)
items.detect: python3 - : semantic == ['action'] and any(pos.startswith('verb')) over entries/
items.notes: Measured 2026-07-30 across all 30,049 entries. 'action' IS in VALID_SEMANTIC, so the unknown-semantic detector is blind to it by construction — the defect is tautology, not invalidity: pos:['verb-godan'] + semantic:['action'] tells a learner nothing about domain. Same shape as tag-sole-general one category over. No migration table possible; destination depends on meaning and is often two tags (かかる → time-general + money). Cap per run — this is a standing lane, not a sweep. Good first cut: verbs whose gloss already names a domain the taxonomy has a tag for. Examples fixed 2026-07-30: 00684 歌う→music, 06701 差し引く→finance, 06704 飛び付く→movement.

items.title: Cross-reference with neither target_id nor label (renders as nothing)
items.detect: scan cross_references[] for objects with no target_id and no label
items.notes: Measured 2026-07-30: 64 refs dictionary-wide lack target_id; 59 of them carry a label and are INTENTIONAL pointers to entry-less words (homophone/contrast display refs) — do not touch those. The 5 unlabeled ones are defects: 06057 (推薦する), 06060 (創造する), 06063 (肯定する), 29601 (年少), 29610 (炭素). validate.py checks that a target_id resolves, not that one is present, so these pass and render as nothing. The durable fix is a schema clause 'target_id OR label required' — NOT a bare required:[target_id], which would break the 59.

SIZED 2026-08-21 (wiki harvest), the first scope estimate this item has ever carried: **46 entries** dictionary-wide, measured as notes containing >=3 '->' plus a '・...->...(negative|past|te-form|polite|potential)' bullet. User-visible: reader currently sees plain text where a working link exists. Analysis: topics/inline-link-integrity.md. | Update 2026-08-02: re-measured at 3,809 resolving of 7,324. Provenance split added: 447 markers (317 entries) have a target created BEFORE the entry the marker sits in, so they were wrong when written rather than stale -- all below ID 07000, 301 of them full-headword/unique-target. Emit a wrong_when_written column (those need no sense-drift check); do NOT build a second detector. RE-MEASURED 2026-08-07 against build/word_id_lookup.json: 7,386 noentry markers total; 2,633 instances across 2,351 distinct MULTI-CHARACTER base forms now resolve. A further 403 instances on 189 SINGLE-character bases must NOT be bulk-fixed — mostly bound morphemes inside compounds (業, 形, 角) where the marker is correct and the resolving entry is a different word. Hand-confirmed resolutions: 二時間->27637, 何時間->30372, お願いいたします->27603, 料理屋->27551, リスト->09786, ネットショッピング->29757, 釣り銭->27568, 佐藤->27597, 便数->30234, 粉薬->27515, 三階->27617, 一万->27599, 千万->28267. The population GROWS with every new-entries run, which is the argument for build/check_stale_noentry.py as a standing read-only detector rather than repeated hand sweeps. | 2026-08-08 systemic-fix run: built the standing detector build/check_stale_noentry.py (read-only, classes A1/A2/A3/B/C/D/R + wrong_when_written) and swept 999 pairs / 1,129 instances across 739 entries — every mechanical pair with a base of 4+ characters, plus the hand-reviewed 2-3 character pairs below entry 00443. External self-check of a 60-pair stratified sample: 0 flagged. THE 'MECHANICAL, PRECISION ~1.0' CLAIM IS WRONG FOR SHORT BASES: hand review of 110 short-base pairs found ~4% false positives — polysemous katakana loanwords (フライ in a baseball sentence -> 11124 deep-fried food), abbreviations (パン in 海パン -> 00553 bread), and homographs read differently. The last family is now caught mechanically by the detector's class R (surface furigana contradicts the target's reading); the first two need a human/model read of context. Class R is also a free by-product queue of 40 genuine furigana errors in source entries (来春->らいはる, 農作物->のうさくもつ, 墓石->はかいし, 完全試合->かんぜんしあい). | 2026-08-11 systemic-fix run: swept entries 01440-02229 — 178 pairs / 198 instances across 134 entries, all A1/A2, each judged against a +/-45-character context window around the marker. Two rejections, both a NEW false-positive family: **proper names whose target entry carries only the common-noun sense** (01440's 朝日新聞/毎日新聞, where 23495_asahi is 'morning sun' and 00729_mainichi is 'every day' — the newspaper is named after the word but the reader clicking it lands on the wrong sense). This family is distinct from the polysemous-loanword and abbreviation families and is NOT caught by class R, because the readings agree. Place-name targets used as place names (上野動物園 -> 28394_ueno, 横浜/札幌) are fine and were applied. Running false-positive rate across 358 hand-verified short-base pairs: ~0.6%. | 2026-08-12 systemic-fix run: swept entries 02232-03163 — 180 pairs / 214 instances across 147 entries, all A1/A2, each judged against a +/-45-character context window around the marker. **Zero rejections** — the first fully clean band. Running false-positive rate across 538 hand-verified short-base pairs: ~0.4%. Families verified as groups in this band: date/counter words (十一日/十四日/七人/六人/二枚 -> the 30xxx counter entries), meat compounds (羊肉/馬肉), surname examples in phone-call entries (田中/山田/鈴木 -> 0952x, where the target entries ARE the surnames), place names used as places (成田/横浜/青森県), grammar terms (五段活用 -> 28275_godan, whose entry covers both 'fifth dan' and the grammar sense), and figurative compounds whose target entry carries the literal word the metaphor is built on (猫に小判 -> 27868 koban coin, 歩行者天国 -> 27976 heaven, 手玉に転がす -> 28101 juggling ball) — these are NOT the proper-name false-positive family, because the metaphor is transparent and the target entry is the same lexeme. One marginal apply worth noting: ソフト飲料 -> 01532_sofuto, whose sense 2 ('soft') covers the collocation only approximately. | 2026-08-13 systemic-fix run: swept entries 03167-03756 — 181 pairs / 221 instances across 131 entries, all A1/A2, each judged against a +/-60-character context window around the marker. **Zero rejections** — the second consecutive fully clean band. Running false-positive rate across 719 hand-verified short-base pairs: ~0.3%. Families verified as groups in this band: suffix entries (〜家/〜者/〜的/〜代/〜戦 -> 28339/04662/09839/28331/28346, where the marker surface is the bare kanji and the base carries the tilde), needle/fence/twin compound sets (縫い針/編み針/注射針/釣り針, 板塀/石塀, 三つ子/四つ子/双生児), katakana loanwords whose target entry has the needed sense as a later sense (ベスト -> 04681 sense 'best', カード -> 03836 sense 1 'identification, payment', マネー, タイル, シニア), and grammar/science terms (感動詞, 中性子/陽子, 重力場/電磁場). Two marginal applies worth recording: 年寄り臭い -> 01133_kusai, whose glosses cover only 'smelly' and 'suspicious' but whose notes have a full AS A SUFFIX (〜くさい) section, so the learner does land in the right place; and 焼き物 -> 04974_yakimono, whose lead gloss is 'grilled dish' with 'pottery, ceramics' as a later sense — same lexeme, so applied, matching the 五段活用 -> 28275 precedent. | 2026-08-14 systemic-fix run: swept entries 03757-04458 — 174 pairs / 210 instances across 141 entries, all A1/A2, each judged against a +/-60-character context window around the marker. **Zero rejections** — the third consecutive fully clean band. Running false-positive rate across 893 hand-verified short-base pairs: ~0.2%. Two borderline classes were checked against the source entries and applied: compound-element markers whose target entry documents that very compound role (込む -> 00719_komu in 持ち込む/打ち込む/押し込む, whose notes carry an explicit '〜込む (compound suffix: into)' line; 思い -> 10248_omoi in 思い浮かぶ, whose notes list 思い出/思い入れ/思い込み as COMMON COMPOUNDS) — same precedent as 年寄り臭い -> 01133_kusai. Families verified as groups: morphological-decomposition notes in compound-verb entries (取り除く = 取る + 除く, 振り返る = 振る + 返る, 再生 = 再〜 + 生), kendo/karate equipment and scoring terms (小手/組み手/面), Tokyo district names used as places (上野/浅草/新宿/成田), medical term lists (心不全/狭心症/心電図/弁膜症/見当識), plant and food compounds (甘栗/毬栗/白桃/甘柿/銀杏/芍薬/藤棚), and katakana loanwords whose target entry carries the needed sense (ツボ 'the right spot', オール 'oar', エース 'top player'). The 銀杏 pair is a good demonstration of class R working: the tree reading いちょう and the nut reading ぎんなん are distinguished, and only the ぎんなん marker was linked to 28490_ginnan. | 2026-08-16 systemic-fix run: swept entries 04459-04999 — 177 pairs / 212 instances across 120 entries, all A1/A2, each judged against a +/-60-character context window. **One rejection**: 04562's 二重ロック -> 08116_rokku, whose gloss is 'rock (music)' and whose notes state outright that ロック 'lock' is a different word with the same reading. That prose self-declaration is a mechanically detectable signal — a candidate new detector class ('target entry notes say X as Y is a different word' -> demote out of the mechanical bucket) that would have caught this and the 2026-08-08 フライ/パン rejections without semantic judgment. Running false-positive rate across 1,070 hand-verified short-base pairs: ~0.2%. Marginal applies resolved by opening the target entry rather than trusting its gloss (the 2026-08-14 rule): 連立方程式 -> 14492_renritsu (notes name the math sense), kindergarten 年少/年長 -> 29613/29601 (collocation list names the kindergarten group), washing-machine おしゃれ着コース -> 10864_koosu sense 2 'program', and bare-kanji-surface/full-word-base markers 購読料 -> 03797_ryoukin and 購 -> 03057_kounyuu. Families verified as groups: 〜者/〜長 title lists (04662, 04665), traditional-arts vocabulary, bird and plant name lists, kitchen/appliance terms, tax and finance compounds, and compound-decomposition notes. | 2026-08-20 systemic-fix run: swept entries 05000-05857 — 179 pairs / 208 instances across 137 entries, all A1/A2, each judged against a +/-70-character context window. **Two rejections, both in the 'target entry's own notes declare a same-reading different word' family**: 05053's comet-anatomy コマ -> 11110_koma (manga panel / class period, whose notes carry a homophone note listing 駒 and 独楽 but not the astronomical coma), and 05762's ロック解除 -> 08116_rokku, the exact pair rejected at 04562 on 2026-08-16. That family has now fired three times (フライ/パン 2026-08-08, ロック 2026-08-16, コマ+ロック 2026-08-20) and remains the strongest candidate for a new mechanical detector class: scan the target entry's notes for a 'X as Y is a different word with the same reading' self-declaration and demote such pairs out of the mechanical bucket. Running false-positive rate across 1,251 hand-verified short-base pairs: ~0.3%. Marginal applies resolved by opening the target entry rather than trusting its gloss (the 2026-08-14 rule): 05387's 日光 -> 03515_nikkou, glossed only 'sunlight' but whose notes state outright that 日光 is also the Tochigi tourist destination — so unlike the 2026-08-11 朝日新聞 proper-name family, the reader does land on the right sense; and ヘビー級 -> 29473_hebii (05235, 05515), same lexeme with no contradicting note. Families verified as groups in this band: geometry vocabulary (六角形/内角/角錐/角柱/表面積), arithmetic terms (四則演算, 円周率, 対数, 線形代数), medical and anatomy lists (歯周病/胆汁/冠動脈/頸動脈/聴診/三角巾/ガーゼ), wedding-ceremony types (神前式/教会式/人前式/釣書/余興), school-club and student-council terms (運動部/文化部/児童会/学生会), milestone-birthday lists (古希/喜寿), banking terms (当座/ATM/手数), place names used as places (新宿/広島/箱根/軽井沢/鎌倉/富山県/伊豆諸島), and compound-element markers whose target entry documents that compound role (しゃがみ込む -> 00719_komu, 寝返り's 返る -> 29164_kaeru, 卸売's 卸す -> 02463_orosu), matching the 2026-08-14 precedent. | 2026-08-25 systemic-fix run: swept entries 05879-06388 — 173 pairs / 196 instances across 116 entries, all A1/A2, each judged against a +/-70-character context window. **Two rejections, both polysemous katakana loanwords**: 05909's スマホのロック -> 08116_rokku (rock music — the fourth firing of this exact target, after 04562, 05762, and the 2026-08-08 フライ/パン pair), and 06183's スクロールバー -> 07060_baa (a drinking establishment; the marker sits in a scrollbar collocation list). Running false-positive rate across 1,426 hand-verified short-base pairs: ~0.4%. **The proposed 'target notes declare a same-reading different word' detector class was tested against this band and needs a refinement to be usable**: the naive scan fired on 7 of 175 pairs at 1/7 precision, because good entries routinely disambiguate themselves from OTHER homophones (臨む vs 望む, 端午 vs 単語, 利く vs 聞く/効く, 生む vs 産む, 五円玉 vs ご縁). The declaration is a demotion signal only when it names the marker's own base form, as ロック's notes do; that test keeps all 6 good pairs, catches ロック, and would have caught フライ/パン/コマ. It would NOT have caught the バー rejection, whose target entry contrasts バー only with 居酒屋 and スナック — so the class raises precision but does not replace reading the context. Families verified as groups in this band: zodiac sign names (12 pairs in 06313), omikuji fortune levels (中吉/小吉/末吉), medical and anatomical compounds (胆嚢/膵臓癌/飛沫/胸痛/電解質/熱性痙攣), corporate-finance terms (監査役/決算書/決算期/不渡り/当座/使用料), funeral and Buddhist vocabulary (火葬/忌明け/服す/仏事/仏前/香道/聞香), aviation terms (駐機場/降下/降機/航空法/空撮), gardening supplies (培養土/鉢底石/鉢皿/植木屋), and counter/number words (一曲/何時間/何十年/三大). Marginal applies resolved by opening the target entry rather than trusting its gloss (the 2026-08-14 rule): 06259's ヘビーゲーマー/コアゲーマー -> 29473_hebii and 29474_koa, whose entries carry 'intense, demanding' and 'hardcore, devoted (modifier)' respectively; 06305's 当座小切手 -> 29548_touza sense 2 'current account'; 06347's 邪気を追い払う -> 29599_jaki sense 2 'evil spirit'; and 06375's 大器晩成 -> 29641_taiki, the literal-decomposition precedent. One incidental repair: 06303 carried the marker surface `{ローン}` — kana wrapped in furigana braces with no reading, which validate.py does not flag; fixed while rewriting that marker, and logged as a [pattern] observation with two more instances (06299 めまい, 06301 ふくらはぎ) left in place.

items.filter: none needed -- all 201 hits sit inside six contiguous creation blocks (04470-04563, 24159-24188, 24539-24558, 24786-24815, 25222-25245, 25301-25330)

The renderer emits gloss and explanation separately, so these entries show the learner the same text twice. Safe mechanical action is DROP the duplicate: schema.json requires only sense_number and gloss, so removing a verbatim duplicate removes no information and cannot introduce a false claim (same drop-vs-migrate asymmetry as the off-vocab tag work). Writing real explanations is a content task for the polish frontier, not a sweep. Detector belongs in check_consistency.py -- see tooling-backlog item 68.

Conjugation tables are hard-coded in the entry JSON and rendered in full, so every wrong row is live: 00557 できる (BASIC tier) publishes できられる and できろ; 01165 見える publishes 見えられる; 01229 聞こえる publishes 聞こえられる. The entry-internal self-declaration test (prose says 'potential form', table still has a Potential row) returns 6 and all 6 are true positives; it under-generates (見える does not say so in prose), so a short curated list is needed. Fix = delete the Potential/Passive/Imperative rows for that set; suppression is safe by construction (an omitted row teaches nothing, a wrong row teaches ungrammatical Japanese). Generator-side guard in tooling-backlog item 70.

items.notes: Measured 2026-08-04 by the wiki harvest, from a 2026-08-03 accuracy-review run that corrected six body-adjacent mistags in one 531-entry range. The project's tags are denotational (the accuracy reviewer judges each tag against the headword), so a verb can never denote a body part -- detection is free and needs no corpus comparison, only the destination needs judgment. In-list destinations exist and this is NOT the P20 vocabulary gap: health (火傷, 日焼け, 閉経, 大便, 化膿), appearance (中肉中背, カール), action (あくびをする, さする), body-internal (organs). Generalises to any concrete-thing tag (body-part, body-internal, tool, furniture, clothing, animal-*, plant-*) on a verb-only entry: that is a type error.

items.title: `・` used for note bullet lists instead of `- ` -- 2,496 entries silently lose 10 note-quality points
items.detect: python3 - : for each entry, count lines in `notes` whose stripped form starts with ・
items.filter: line-initial ・ only; a mid-line ・ is the katakana middle dot and must not be touched
items.notes: Measured 2026-08-15 across 30,464 entries: 2,496 entries / 18,089 bullet lines. .claude/skills/vocabulary-notes/SKILL.md mandates '- ' and build/score_note_quality.py credits only '- ', so each of these entries loses a flat 10 points for a typographic defect and is pushed up polishing/priority/notes.txt -- 130 of the top 500 priority entries (26%) carry the shape. Transformation is regex ^・ -> '- ' on the notes field only; a line-initial ・ cannot be the katakana separator, so this is the 'provably cannot introduce an error' class, but still validate and spot-check. No generator emits ・ bullets, so unlike P59/P60 there is no generator to fix first. Re-run `make priorities` after the sweep or the ranking keeps the pre-sweep order. | 2026-08-23 wiki harvest reproduced the ranking distortion at a different depth (24 of the top 100 priority lines, matching 130 of the top 500) and added the base rate the earlier measurement lacked: 8.1% dictionary-wide (2,484 of 30,524), so the top of the list is enriched 3x for a typographic property. Still NOT the binding defect -- 76 of the top 100 are not `・` entries -- so this stays sequenced behind the Tooling 20 scorer-bug pair and its structured-note credit, which has named `・` blocks as quality signal since 2026-07-02.

items.title: The interrogative family: 12 basic-tier entries carrying six semantic labels and four POS labels
items.detect: enumerate by headword: 何 誰 いつ どこ どう どれ どの どうして どちら なぜ どんな 何で (00498 00534 00536 00539 00543 00547 00551 00834 00927 01484 02924 03875) and compare metadata.tags.semantic / .pos set-wise
items.filter: the twelve entries listed; the set is closed, so membership needs no judgment
items.notes: Measured 2026-08-23 by the wiki harvest, from two independent observations arriving at the same family from opposite ends: a 2026-08-21 polish run found 00534 誰 carrying the off-list tag `interrogative` and guessed 'likely a small family worth migrating together'; a 2026-08-22 accuracy-review run found 01484 なぜ tagged pos ['noun'] while どうして/なんで are both 'adverb' and guessed 'worth checking the whole interrogative family'. Both guesses are right. All twelve entries are BASIC tier -- among the most-looked-up in the dictionary -- and carry six different semantic labels (interrogative x2 OFF-LIST, grammatical x4, direction x2, descriptive x2, general x1, NOTHING AT ALL x2) and four POS labels (pronoun x5, adverb x4, pre-noun-adjectival x2, noun x1). Three sub-defects are unambiguous: (a) `interrogative` on 00534/00543 is off-list, hence a P20 migration by definition (both already in build/data/unknown_semantic_baseline.json); (b) pos ['noun'] on 01484 なぜ is plainly wrong for an interrogative adverb, and its two synonyms 00834/03875 are both 'adverb'; (c) 00498 何 and 02924 どんな carry no semantic tag at all, which is tag-missing-semantic-entirely territory. The other labels are each defensible alone and only wrong beside each other. FILED needs-decision, NOT open: the item is blocked on one convention ruling -- which in-list semantic tag the family takes. `grammatical` is the plurality (4 of the 10 tagged) and the only candidate that fits all twelve; adopting it would retire `interrogative` from the off-list tail and give the direction/descriptive members a consistent home. Migrating without the ruling just re-scatters the family. Same shape as tag-lexical-family-incoherence (P38) but on a closed set with no membership ambiguity, so it is the better second family to size that instrument on.

items.title: screening_status.json is missing 12,016 of the 22,991 screening results on disk
items.detect: compare the entry ids of reviews/screening/[0-9]*.json against the keys of reviews/screening/screening_status.json['screened']
items.filter: result files absent from the index; the index is a strict subset, so the difference is exactly the lost writes
items.notes: build/review_runner.py calls save_screening_status once, after the screening loop (line 377), while per-entry results are written inside it. Any interruption discards the whole run's index updates and keeps the files. Fix is (a) rebuild the index from the result files -- every one carries entry_id, flagged and screened_at, so no API calls are needed -- then (b) checkpoint the index inside the loop. Rebuilding also implements item 114's --rescreen-before for free, and un-strands the 1,947 flags produced by the pre-2026-08-16 prompt.

Required sections are 30 of 100 points and verb-suru declares exactly one, so 2,499 entries are capped at 70 for a heading name. 76 of the worst-scoring 100 in polishing/priority/notes.txt are this class against an 18.8% base rate (4x enrichment), so the notes priority ranking should not be trusted for lane planning until this is settled. items.title: `existence` is an in-list semantic tag with no documented denotation -- 129 entries

items.notes: 129 entries, 102 of them verbs. The accuracy reviewer flags it repeatedly on stative/intransitive verbs (14449, 14468, 14625, 14612, 14370) and every flag rejects because the proposed replacements are worse.
